info.title: DeepSeek Tools API
info.description: DeepSeek standalone tool APIs: web Search/Fetch, document OCR, speech recognition (ASR), text-to-speech (TTS). Search/Fetch billed CNY 5 per 1000 successful requests; OCR CNY 1.5 per 1000 pages; ASR CNY 0.78/hour (limited-time 50% off); TTS CNY 3 per 10k chars (limited-time 50% off, han = 2 chars). Docs: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/search/

query.description: Search terms (1-128 chars, not all whitespace). Supports operators: site: -site: -word -"phrase" "exact phrase" lang:zh,en after:2025-01-01 before:2026

count.description: Number of results to return; does not affect price

ori_question.description: The user's original question that triggered the search; improves intent matching

localization.description: IP address used to prioritize localized results

need_content.description: Return page body text in each result's content field

200.description: results[]: rerank_score(0-3, >=1.5 good), title, url, snippet(100-200 chars), summary(600-800 chars, for models), content(only if need_content), site_name, site_icon, date(RFC3339), authority(0-4, >=3 very authoritative)

post.summary: Fetch one web page as Markdown

url.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL with a host; no username/password. Subject to target site availability and policy

200.description: {title, content}: page title and Markdown body

post.summary: OCR documents/images, text returned per page
post.description: Accepts PDF/DOC/DOCX/PPT/PPTX and PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP/TIFF (format judged by content). Limits: 100 MiB, 1000 pages, 180s total including upload. The server streams newlines as keep-alive, then returns one JSON object. Page text keeps <｜ref｜>/<｜box｜> markers with coordinates normalized to 0-1000 for rich_layout_recognition. Billed per recognized page.

purpose.description: text_recognition extracts text from plain Word/PPT directly; rich_layout_recognition recognizes every page with layout markers

200.description: {page_count, pages[{index, text, finish_reason}], usage}: pages[].text is raw model output; finish_reason=length means that page is truncated

post.description: 16-bit PCM WAV (8k-48k Hz) or Ogg Opus, mono/stereo (stereo uses left channel), max 8 MiB, max 120 seconds. Language is auto-detected (21 languages), no parameter. Not streaming.

post.summary: Synthesize text to speech audio (whole text, streaming response body)
post.description: Audio streams back as synthesis runs; max 30 minutes per request. 10 languages auto-detected. If the connection drops mid-response the synthesis failed. No speed control. Streaming text input needs the WebSocket endpoint (not exposed here).

text.description: Text to read; max 10000 billed characters (han = 2 chars each); request body max 64 KiB

voice_id.description: stella = Haixing female (default), tide = Anchao male

200.description: audio/wav (or raw PCM) bytes; save with -o
